verses.text: May the hands of Abi Lahab[1] be ruined, and may he be ruined!
His wealth did[2] not avail him, nor did what he earned.
He will roast in a flaming fire,
while his wife[3], that firewood carrier [4]—
around her neck is a rope of palm fiber.

footnotes.1: The uncle of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), and one of his fiercest enemies.
footnotes.2: Frequently the Qur’an addresses the events of the Hereafter in past tense; this grammatical shift should be pondered by the reader.
footnotes.3: Abu Lahab’s wife who used to throw thorns in the way of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him).
footnotes.4: Qira’at: All except for Asem read it as: “…while his wife, the firewood carrier— 5 5 around…”
